entities.text: DAYARAM Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: First and second applications have been dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 14.09.2023 & 06.09.2024.

The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363,
366, 376(3) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo RI for 3 years with fine of Rs.1000/-, RI for 7 years with fine of Rs.1000/-, RI for 20 years with fine of Rs.1000/- & RI for 20 years with fine of Rs.1000/- respectively, with default stipulation.

Learned counsel for appellant argued that the present application has been filed mainly on the ground that the appellant has already undergone jail sentence more than 5 & 1/2 years and the final hearing of the appeal may take time.

She argued that the prosecutrix was a consenting party,
however because of the age, the appellant has been convicted.
As per the scholar register, the age of the prosecutrix is 14 years 5 months, but no source of recording the age in the scholar register has been proved by the prosecution witnesses.
She further argued that the age of the appellant was also 18 years & 6 months on the date of the incident.
The appeal is of the year 2023 and final hearing of the same may take time, hence remaining jail sentence of the present appellant be suspended.
2 CRA-2710-2023 Counsel for the respondent / State opposed the prayer and prays for dismissal of the application.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the testimony of the witnesses, that no source has been proved by the prosecution regarding recording of the date of birth in the scholar register, the age of the appellant was also less than 19 years on the date of the incident, coupled with the fact that appellant has already undergone jail sentence of 5 years & 4 months and final hearing of the appeal may take time being of the year 2023, we deem it expedient to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 14.05.2026, and thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.
